pdfjs-dist 6.5.438, legacy build
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0. See pdfjs-6.5.438/LICENSE.

pdfjs-6.5.438/pdf.min.js, pdf.worker.min.js, cmaps/, and standard_fonts/ are the same files the
PDF editor vendors. This tool reads text and does not draw pages, so the image decoders in wasm/
and the ICC profiles in iccs/ are not included.
